definition: Power is either intrinsic to its bearer or borrowed from an immediately prior powered bearer for which an inductively finite derivation of power already exists. A source is a constructive witness rather than a stipulated first temporal event.
note: One rigorous reading of derived or essential power; it is not definitionally identified with DEF-PER-SE-EFFICIENT-CAUSE-LINK. That identification would be an independently needed metaphysical/source-reading premise, not a free Lean definition.
